description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of various multilingual BERT models on morphosyntactic probing tasks across different language families and types, with the y-axis labeled "effect" ranging from 0 to 30 in increments of 10. The x-axis categorizes the data by language group, including IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. Each category contains multiple colored bars representing different models: mBERT (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). Error bars are shown for each bar, indicating variability in the effect measurements. The chart shows that the effect values vary significantly across models and language groups, with the highest effects observed in the IE-Romance and IE-Slavic family categories, particularly for the XLM-B₂ model. The mBERT model generally shows lower effect values compared to the other models across most categories. The data suggests that the performance of these models in morphosyntactic probing tasks is influenced by both the model architecture and the linguistic characteristics of the language families.
